description: Le stationnement 2 roues à Argenteuil (donnée publique) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Argenteuil. Parking for both wheels on the territory of the city of Argenteuil. Data created in May 2015 Updated in May 2021 Digitisation: 1/500 Base: ortho photo aerodata 2018 + field 10 parking lots still need to be checked: existence and number of places (2 in Val Nord, 4 in Orgemont and 4 in Val Notre ... Coverage: Ville d'Argenteuil. The portal shows the English title as "2-wheel parking in Argenteuil (public data)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Argenteuil. Its keywords include reseau-cyclable, stationnement, voirie, velo, geospatial, mobilite. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, WEB PAGE, KML, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-05-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
